evidence.quote: Het instellingscollegegeldtarief geldt alleen voor studenten die niet voldoen aan de voorwaarden voor het wettelijk collegegeld.
De tarieven voor instellingscollegegeld in 2026-2027 Bachelor, Associate degree & bekostigde master (voltijd, deeltijd & duaal) € 10.747

notes: Tuition: two quotes are given—one states who pays the instellingscollegegeld (students who do not meet the conditions for the statutory fee), one gives the amount for 2026-2027 for bachelor programmes (voltijd, deeltijd & duaal). The fact that the programme is 4 years was quoted from the programme page (it mentions 'Bachelor 4 jaar'). The application deadline is taken from the Inschrijvingsregeling HU, which says students living abroad must register before 1 September; this is an institution-wide rule for full-time bachelor programmes and applies to this programme. The programme page itself mentions 'Aanmelddeadline t/m 1 mei en 31 januari' but does not specify for whom, so the institution-wide rule for students abroad was used. No specific document list for this programme was found. The start moment September and February is on the programme page but no evidence was provided for the number of intakes, so it was omitted. No tuition fee specific to this programme was found.

note.en: Check admission requirements for international students on the HU international website (foreign diploma, equivalences).
